title: Grain Desk Standing Rule: The Forward Position Ceiling Across a Member's Portfolio
content:
Bushels sold forward under Grain Marketing Contracts are capped across the whole portfolio rather than contract by contract.

## Clauses in force

**1. Where the percentage and the window come from.** The ceiling is the cap percentage of the member's production history average, and both the percentage and the length of the history window are taken from the programme of the contract being written, not from the programmes already held.

**2. Amendments.** An amendment that raises contracted bushels is measured against the cap only while the contract stands in active or delivering, and an amendment that lowers them is never blocked by the cap. The standing of the contract is read off the contract record against the contract number, before the change is registered.

**3. Where the ceiling would be passed.** The desk writes the contract for the remaining headroom and declines the balance, or declines outright where there is no headroom; it never writes the contract over the ceiling to be trued up afterwards.

**4. A member with no history at all.** A member who has no delivery history at all has no production history average, so no forward contract can be measured, and the request is not one this rule can decide.

## Clauses no longer in force

Two clauses of this rule are **no longer in force** and are carried here only so that no reader applies them:

> "A new contract is written only where the bushels already open plus the bushels being committed stay at or under the ceiling."

> "The member's open forward position for a crop year is the bushels still owed on every contract of theirs for that crop year that stands in active or delivering, and it is measured against the member's production history average, which is the average net bushels they delivered per crop year over the completed crop years in the production history window, a member with fewer completed years being measured on the years they have."

Neither sentence governs the bushels a contract is written for any longer.

## Points of judgement

An amendment lowering contracted bushels on a contract standing in delivering is not measured against the ceiling at all. An amendment raising them on a contract standing in applied is outside the clause, because the clause reaches only a contract standing in active or delivering. The cap percentage and the history window are always those of the programme now being written, even where the member's other contracts sit on more generous programmes.
